behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; the only argument register read is rdi. Fields read: qword at [rdi+8], then the chain [p], [p+8], [q+0x10], [r+0xcb8]. No field is written.
behavior.entry_shape: Straight-line load chain with one forward branch and one ret; no loop, no call opcode inside the window.
behavior.return_rule: rax = [rdi+8]; if rax == [rax], return -1; else rax = [rax+8], rax = [rax+0x10], return [rax+0xcb8].
behavior.weakness: Pair-load class (cf. packet #40): the deep-deref shape is familiar, and the -1 default on a self-compare gate is the distinctive element. The window is bound only because its full chain and gate lock exactly from its own bytes, not because it is shown to belong to a wider family.

caller_fdes.note: Site confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from the caller FDE start; caller setup immediately before the call is mov 0xcb8(%rax),%rbp, preceded by add $0x8f0,%rdi; caller purpose not claimed.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; the site was additionally confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.

scout_corrections: The round-12 scout note listed this window (ranked #4) with FDE [0x5172e50, 0x5172e77), 39 bytes, 9 padding bytes, one direct caller boundary-confirmed, and no naming relocation. Every element verified exactly, including the full three-load chain ([rdi+8] -> [p+8] -> [q+0x10] -> [r+0xcb8]), the self-compare gate, and the nearest claimed window (tiny two-byte gate 0x51647b0, packet #72, 0xe6a0 away). No numeric correction to the scout's numbers was needed. One phrasing point is reconciled explicitly: the scout's 'zero calls' describes the window body (no call opcode inside it), while the one direct site is an incoming call from one caller FDE — the two statements are about different directions and do not conflict.
